title: CommandRule
description: Command prefix rule (FR-191, docs/12 §3.1). A rule matches a command's leading words (split by a shell-grammar parser without expansion); each pattern element is a literal word or a list of alternatives. Every matchExamples entry must match and every notMatchExamples entry must not; both are checked when rules load and one failure rejects the whole rule file. A compound command matches an allow rule only if every part does; an ask or deny applies if any part matches. Unparseable commands never match allow. An allow decides only whether to ask: it never removes the sandbox or widens the permission profile (ADR-059).

tools.description: Exec tools the rule applies to.

justification.description: Shown in prompts and denials; a deny names the alternative, which is returned to the agent.

hostExecutables.description: Absolute paths a bare command name may resolve to besides the sandbox PATH.

oneOf.description: A command line, split with shell rules.
